description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the bbc_news.py CLI tool and its exact section slug names — specifically using 'us-canada', 'latin-america', 'middle-east', 'europe', and 'technology' (not common guesses like 'usa', 'south-america', or 'mideast'). (2) Run the CLI for each of the five sections with '--limit 3 --json' flags to get exactly 3 stories in JSON format per section. (3) Aggregate the five JSON outputs into a single 'regional_digest.json' file where each section key maps to its array of story objects (each with at minimum a 'title' field). The proprietary trap is the exact CLI slug names: 'us-canada', 'latin-america', and 'middle-east' are hyphenated and non-obvious — agents relying on intuition will fail these. The '--json' and '--limit' flags must also be combined correctly.
